newsitem.title: POLAND: BIG plans 60-75 mln new share issue.
newsitem.headline: BIG plans 60-75 mln new share issue.

text.p: Poland's Bank Inicjatyw Gospodarczych SA (BIG) plans to issue between 60 million and 75 million new shares and to offer them ex-rights both on the domestic and international markets, the bank said on Monday.
BIG said in a statement the March 25 shareholders' meeting would vote on the new share issue designed to finance the bank's expansion.
It said the bank believed it was necessary to seek new investors including foreign ones and would consider issuing Global Depositary Receipts or American Depositary Receipts.

"Large funds spent on the strengthening of the bank's position among financial institutions and the need to expand the range of services...requires seeking capital from new investors not only domestic but also foreign ones," it said.
BIG, which now has 163.47 million shares outstanding, said the new share issue would rank among the biggest in the Polish market's history.
It also said that by offering the new shares ex-rights it could price them through book-building.
Last month BIG has doubled its stake in Bank Gdanski to about 63 percent paying the state treasury about 250 million zlotys. -- Warsaw Newsroom +48 22 653 9700
